scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This collection contains blueprints, surveys, and technical drawings covering the Pocantico Hills "Kykuit" estate, family offices in Rockefeller Center, surveys of land holdings in Maine (Seal Harbor, Mount Desert Island) and Wyoming (J-Y Ranch), Rockefeller University in New York City, and the Rockefeller Laboratory in St. Lucia.

arrangement.p: This collection is arranged as follows:
